description: One row for every captured accepted guess, with complete six-turn outcomes and first-turn partition measurements.
method: All 14,855 accepted guesses are ranked by mean turns among solved games in a six-turn, normal-mode fixed-policy simulation over 2,354 answers. First-turn partition columns use the current 2,373-answer working pool. The two scopes are identified separately and must not be blended.

average_guesses, win_rate_percent, volat.method: fixed-policy normal-mode simulation capped at six guesses
